overview: Turret Trench is a timed first-person station-infiltration fixture. Progress through two bunker controls and then time the turret override to the safe half of a repeating sweep cycle. The implemented failure check is the cycle phase when the override is pressed.
rules: Use bunker station one to enable station two, then use station two to enable the override.
The repeating sweep timer advances the cycle phase.
Interact with the override on an odd cycle phase to complete the match.
Pressing the override on an even phase loses the match; disabled stations cannot skip progression.
controls: WASD/arrows move; mouse looks; Shift sprints; Space jumps; Ctrl crouches.
Approach and aim at an enabled control, then press E to interact.
Escape opens the native menu; F5/F9 quick-save/load in the stock client.
story: The scenario presents an unnamed infiltrator reaching a turret override through bunker stations. No named character cast or extended narrative is established.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
